title: Flower Pot Forests
description: plant your pot, wait some time, watch the forests grow
body:
# FlowerPot Forests v2.5.1

**Plant saplings in flower pots and watch them spread into forests!**

### Open the settings menu

```
/trigger fpf_trigger set 1
```

## Bugs

- May create dense forests if spread count is set very high.
- Large spread ranges can impact performance.

## Usage

Free to use in modpacks and any other projects.

---

## Commands

### Trigger menu shortcuts (non-OP)

These match the clickable buttons in the menu.

```
/trigger fpf_trigger set 1   Open settings menu
/trigger fpf_trigger set 2   Toggle datapack enabled/disabled
/trigger fpf_trigger set 14  Toggle forest spreading
/trigger fpf_trigger set 15  Spread speed preset: Fast (30s)
/trigger fpf_trigger set 16  Spread speed preset: Slow (2 min)
/trigger fpf_trigger set 17  Increase spread interval (+10s)
/trigger fpf_trigger set 18  Decrease spread interval (-10s)
/trigger fpf_trigger set 19  Toggle mycelium spreading
/trigger fpf_trigger set 20  Toggle nylium spreading
/trigger fpf_trigger set 21  Toggle grass spreading
/trigger fpf_trigger set 22  Toggle nether grass spreading
/trigger fpf_trigger set 23  Toggle messages
```

### Direct config functions (OP/admin)

```
/function flowerpotforests:config/menu
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_enabled
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_forest_spread
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_mycelium_spread
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_nylium_spread
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_grass_spread
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_nether_grass_spread
/function flowerpotforests:config/toggle_messages
/function flowerpotforests:config/spread_fast
/function flowerpotforests:config/spread_slow
/function flowerpotforests:config/spread_interval_up
/function flowerpotforests:config/spread_interval_down
/function flowerpotforests:config/limit_up
/function flowerpotforests:config/limit_down
/function flowerpotforests:config/tree_spread_min_up
/function flowerpotforests:config/tree_spread_min_down
/function flowerpotforests:config/tree_spread_max_up
/function flowerpotforests:config/tree_spread_max_down
/function flowerpotforests:config/flower_spread_min_up
/function flowerpotforests:config/flower_spread_min_down
/function flowerpotforests:config/flower_spread_max_up
/function flowerpotforests:config/flower_spread_max_down
```

## Notes

- Most settings are easiest to change via the menu.
- Place any sapling, flower, mushroom, or plant in a flower pot to create a "mother tree".
- Mother trees spread their respective plants in a configurable radius.
- Trees spread saplings, flowers spread flowers, ferns spread ferns and grass blocks.
- Works with all vanilla wood types including pale oak.
- Supports nether fungi, mushrooms, bamboo, cactus, and all flower types.
- Grass spreading converts dirt blocks under ferns, azaleas, and flowering azaleas to grass blocks.

### Supported Plants

**Trees:** Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Pale Oak
**Nether:** Crimson Fungus, Warped Fungus, Crimson Roots, Warped Roots
**Mushrooms:** Red Mushroom, Brown Mushroom
**Plants:** Bamboo, Cactus, Fern, Azalea, Flowering Azalea, Dead Bush
**Flowers:** All 17 vanilla flower types including Wither Rose and Torchflower
